question: On Nov. 4, 1961, Wilt Chamberlain began a streak of straight games scoring 30 or more points. How many games in a row did it last?
question_short: Nov. 4, 1961: Wilt Chamberlain started a streak of 30-point games. How long did it last?
answer_detail: Wilt's run began Nov. 4, 1961, the season he averaged 50.4 points a game. James Harden's 32 straight in 2018-19 is the closest anyone else has come.
answer_short: Wilt scored 30+ in 65 straight games; James Harden's 32 is the next-best run.
